findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.ts:518 covers non-git, unborn HEAD, wrong cwd, and root/worktree mismatch, but no test forces diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot to return missing_material_hash from packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:159. CHK-001 and CHK-002 both mark missing materialHash / unavailable materialHash as must-cover behavior, so this branch can regress without the claimed no-write diagnostic coverage. Severity: high.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in e5779c23: field-regression now creates an empty-HEAD material tree to force missing_material_hash and asserts no currentReviewRound repair or review-run write; build and field-regression/review-loop/authority smokes pass.

findings.desc: review_run_start checks the story phase from ctx.root before resolving the signed workspace, so when cwd is the story worktree but --root/LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT points at main with stale story metadata, the command fails with "story B-3787 must be in REVIEW phase (current: INIT_CHECK)" instead of the intended root/worktree mismatch diagnostic. Repro: from /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate/.worktrees/B-3787, run lattice --root /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate review_run_start {storyId:B-3787,agent:koala-review-delivery}; no reviewer run is created, but the operator guidance is misleading and misses the hard mismatch check promised by CHK-001/CHK-002.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in e5779c23: review_run_start resolves story worktree/root mismatch before phase validation and field-regression asserts LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT pointing at main fails with the root/worktree mismatch diagnostic.
